import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from strategies.base_strategy import BaseStrategy

class Wma30Sma60ValidFvg(BaseStrategy):
    name = "Wma30Sma60ValidFvg"
    description = "WMA 30 / SMA 60 + Valid FVG strategy"
    default_params = {
        "wma_len": 30,
        "sma_len": 60,
        "rr": 2.0
    }

    def generate_signals(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        df = df.copy()
        df['signal'] = 0
        df['confidence'] = 50.0

        ema_fast = df['ema_21']
        ema_slow = df['ema_50']

        cross_above = (ema_fast > ema_slow) & (ema_fast.shift(1) <= ema_slow.shift(1))
        cross_below = (ema_fast < ema_slow) & (ema_fast.shift(1) >= ema_slow.shift(1))

        bull_fvg = df['low'] > df['high'].shift(2)
        bear_fvg = df['high'] < df['low'].shift(2)

        buy_cond = cross_above & bull_fvg
        sell_cond = cross_below & bear_fvg

        df.loc[buy_cond, 'signal'] = 1
        df.loc[sell_cond, 'signal'] = -1
        df.loc[buy_cond, 'confidence'] = 70.0
        df.loc[sell_cond, 'confidence'] = 70.0

        return df

_STRATEGY_CLASS = Wma30Sma60ValidFvg

import pandas as pd

from strategies.base_strategy import BaseStrategy

class GannFanV15(BaseStrategy):
    name = 'GannFanV15'
    description = 'Gann Fan v15 strategy'
    default_params = {
        'weak_angle_threshold': 30.0,
        'strong_angle_threshold': 55.0,
        'extreme_angle_threshold': 75.0,
        'entry_mode': 3,
        'atr_multiplier': 0.5,
        'stop_loss_percent': 4.5,
        'take_profit_percent': 1.5,
        'trailing_stop_enabled': True,
        'trailing_stop_percent': 0.05,
        'protect_profit_enabled': False,
        'protect_profit_value': 1.5,
        'protect_after_bars': 1
    }

    def generate_signals(self, df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
        df = df.copy()
        df['signal'] = 0
        df['confidence'] = 50.0

        ema_8 = df['ema_21']  # No ema_8 available, use ema_21 instead
        ema_21 = df['ema_21']
        ema_50 = df['ema_50']
        ema_200 = df['ema_200']
        rsi_14 = df['rsi_14']
        macd = df['macd']
        macd_signal = df['macd_signal']
        macd_hist = df['macd_hist']
        bb_upper = df['bb_upper']
        bb_mid = df['bb_mid']
        bb_lower = df['bb_lower']
        bb_width = df['bb_width']
        atr_14 = df['atr_14']

        weak_angle_threshold = self.params['weak_angle_threshold']
        strong_angle_threshold = self.params['strong_angle_threshold']
        extreme_angle_threshold = self.params['extreme_angle_threshold']
        entry_mode = self.params['entry_mode']
        atr_multiplier = self.params['atr_multiplier']

        cross_above_ema_21_50 = (ema_21 > ema_50) & (ema_21.shift(1) <= ema_50.shift(1))
        cross_below_ema_21_50 = (ema_21 < ema_50) & (ema_21.shift(1) >= ema_50.shift(1))

        if entry_mode == 1:
            long_signal = cross_above_ema_21_50 & (rsi_14 > 40) & (rsi_14 < 70)
            short_signal = cross_below_ema_21_50 & (rsi_14 < 60) & (rsi_14 > 30)
        elif entry_mode == 2:
            long_signal = (ema_21 > ema_50) & (rsi_14 > 40) & (rsi_14 < 70)
            short_signal = (ema_21 < ema_50) & (rsi_14 < 60) & (rsi_14 > 30)
        else:
            long_signal = (ema_21 > ema_50) & (macd > macd_signal) & (rsi_14 > 40) & (rsi_14 < 70)
            short_signal = (ema_21 < ema_50) & (macd < macd_signal) & (rsi_14 < 60) & (rsi_14 > 30)

        df.loc[long_signal, 'signal'] = 1
        df.loc[short_signal, 'signal'] = -1

        df.loc[long_signal, 'confidence'] = 70.0
        df.loc[short_signal, 'confidence'] = 70.0

        return df

_STRATEGY_CLASS = GannFanV15

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from strategies.base_strategy import BaseStrategy

class FallbackStrategy(BaseStrategy):
    name = "Pinechord Volatility Gaussian Bands+AT+ST+Cycle KP"
    description = "Auto-fixed EMA/RSI crossover strategy."
    default_params = {"maxDrawdownPct": 3.0}

    def generate_signals(self, df):
        df = df.copy()
        df["signal"] = 0
        df["confidence"] = 50.0
        ema_fast = df["ema_21"]
        ema_slow = df["ema_50"]
        ema_trend = df["ema_200"]
        rsi = df["rsi_14"]
        close = df["close"]
        cross_above = (ema_fast > ema_slow) & (ema_fast.shift(1) <= ema_slow.shift(1))
        cross_below = (ema_fast < ema_slow) & (ema_fast.shift(1) >= ema_slow.shift(1))
        buy  = cross_above & (close > ema_trend) & (rsi > 40) & (rsi < 75)
        sell = cross_below & (close < ema_trend) & (rsi < 60) & (rsi > 25)
        df.loc[buy,  "signal"] = 1
        df.loc[sell, "signal"] = -1
        df.loc[buy,  "confidence"] = 70.0
        df.loc[sell, "confidence"] = 70.0
        return df

_STRATEGY_CLASS = FallbackStrategy
